description: Key secondary deployment metrics for EXP-004 (06 issue 2); run plan A approved by Josue 2026-10-17
configurations: as selected by EXP-004 (artifacts/exp004/units/{learner}.jsonl); no re-tuning
seeds: as EXP-004: learner random_state = repeat seed + outer fold; inner folds from src/design/inner_folds.py
training_fold_scores: out-of-fold predictions over the EXP-004 inner folds at the selected configuration
threshold_rule: one threshold per outer unit, both states pooled, from the training fold's IED-free (group F) recordings; at most the target false positives per minute of analysed EEG
sensitivity: per evaluable E patient, share of IED epochs in its evaluable states at or above the threshold; equal patient weight; M1 interval
fp_rate: per held-out IED-free recording, detections per minute, all epochs and per state
calibration: Platt scaling, unweighted logistic regression of training out-of-fold labels on scores
log_loss: per evaluable E patient over its evaluable-state epochs (M1 interval); also pooled over all held-out recordings
calibration_summary: slope and intercept of held-out epochs pooled within a repeat (mean over repeats); 10-bin reliability table
refit_check: outer refit must reproduce the saved EXP-004 held-out scores (max abs diff <= 1e-9), else abort
